facts.text: I asked for feedback on my text answer about Tod’s home life.
I said Tod’s home life is not the best.
I suggested Tod’s family has financial troubles because they cannot afford new windows.
I said broken windows are a need rather than a want.
I said windows are needed to keep from the cold, to be safe, and to have a decent lifestyle.
I wondered whether Tod’s home life would affect his bullying behavior.
I stated that later in the book Tod’s mom works at the dry cleaner.
I said Tod’s mom’s job would not provide enough money.
I said I still do not know what Tod’s stepfather does for a living.
